name: Plant diseases (by cause)
note: Curated list of plant diseases grouped by causal agent, following standard plant pathology classification. Each entry searches the peer-reviewed literature by name and pathogen.

groups.name: Fungal diseases
groups.query: "plant disease" AND (KW:"Fungi" OR KW:"Plant Diseases") AND (fungal OR fungus)

items.name: Rust diseases
items.query: ("rust disease" OR "leaf rust" OR "stem rust" OR "stripe rust" OR Puccinia OR Uromyces) AND (plant OR crop OR wheat OR coffee OR soybean)

items.name: Powdery mildew
items.query: "powdery mildew" AND (plant OR crop)

items.name: Downy mildew
items.query: "downy mildew" AND (plant OR crop)

items.name: Anthracnose
items.query: anthracnose AND (Colletotrichum OR plant OR crop OR mango OR chilli)

items.name: Fusarium wilt
items.query: ("Fusarium wilt" OR "Fusarium oxysporum") AND (plant OR crop OR banana OR tomato OR chickpea)

items.name: Verticillium wilt
items.query: "Verticillium wilt" OR (Verticillium AND wilt AND plant)

items.name: Rice blast
items.query: ("rice blast" OR "Magnaporthe oryzae" OR "Pyricularia oryzae")

items.name: Sheath blight of rice
items.query: ("sheath blight" AND rice) OR ("Rhizoctonia solani" AND rice)

items.name: Late blight
items.query: ("late blight" OR "Phytophthora infestans") AND (potato OR tomato)

items.name: Early blight
items.query: ("early blight" OR "Alternaria solani") AND (potato OR tomato)

items.name: Leaf spot diseases
items.query: ("leaf spot" OR Cercospora OR Septoria OR Alternaria) AND (plant OR crop OR leaf)

items.name: Root rot
items.query: ("root rot" AND (plant OR crop)) OR (Phytophthora AND "root rot") OR (Pythium AND "root rot")

items.name: Damping-off
items.query: "damping-off" OR "damping off" AND (seedling OR Pythium OR Rhizoctonia)

items.name: Smut and bunt
items.query: (smut OR bunt OR Ustilago OR Tilletia OR Sporisorium) AND (plant OR crop OR wheat OR sugarcane OR maize)

items.name: Ergot
items.query: (ergot OR "Claviceps purpurea" OR Claviceps) AND (plant OR crop OR cereal OR rye OR sorghum)

items.name: Botrytis grey mould
items.query: ("Botrytis cinerea" OR "grey mould" OR "gray mold") AND (plant OR fruit OR crop)

items.name: Aflatoxin and storage moulds
items.query: (Aspergillus OR aflatoxin) AND (grain OR groundnut OR peanut OR maize OR storage OR crop)

items.name: Red rot of sugarcane
items.query: ("red rot" AND sugarcane) OR "Colletotrichum falcatum"

items.name: Tikka leaf spot of groundnut
items.query: ("tikka" OR "late leaf spot" OR "early leaf spot") AND (groundnut OR peanut)

groups.name: Bacterial diseases
groups.query: ("bacterial disease" OR phytopathogenic bacteria) AND (plant OR crop)

items.name: Bacterial blight of rice
items.query: ("bacterial blight" AND rice) OR "Xanthomonas oryzae"

items.name: Bacterial wilt
items.query: ("bacterial wilt" OR "Ralstonia solanacearum") AND (plant OR crop OR tomato OR potato OR brinjal)

items.name: Citrus canker
items.query: "citrus canker" OR "Xanthomonas citri"

items.name: Citrus greening (HLB)
items.query: ("citrus greening" OR Huanglongbing OR "Candidatus Liberibacter")

items.name: Soft rot
items.query: ("soft rot" AND (plant OR crop OR potato OR vegetable)) OR Pectobacterium OR "Erwinia carotovora"

items.name: Fire blight
items.query: "fire blight" OR "Erwinia amylovora"

items.name: Crown gall
items.query: "crown gall" OR "Agrobacterium tumefaciens" AND plant

items.name: Bacterial leaf spot and speck
items.query: ("bacterial leaf spot" OR "bacterial speck" OR "Pseudomonas syringae") AND (plant OR crop OR tomato OR pepper)

items.name: Pierce's disease and olive quick decline
items.query: "Xylella fastidiosa"

items.name: Phytoplasma diseases
items.query: (phytoplasma OR "Candidatus Phytoplasma") AND (plant OR crop OR disease)

groups.name: Viral and viroid diseases
groups.query: (KW:"Plant Viruses" OR "plant virus") AND (plant OR crop)

items.name: Tomato leaf curl
items.query: ("tomato leaf curl" OR "tomato yellow leaf curl" OR Begomovirus) AND tomato

items.name: Cotton leaf curl
items.query: "cotton leaf curl" OR (Begomovirus AND cotton)

items.name: Mosaic viruses
items.query: ("mosaic virus" OR "Tobacco mosaic virus" OR "Cucumber mosaic virus" OR "Cassava mosaic") AND plant

items.name: Banana bunchy top
items.query: "banana bunchy top" OR BBTV

items.name: Papaya ringspot
items.query: "papaya ringspot" OR PRSV

items.name: Rice tungro
items.query: "rice tungro" OR tungro

items.name: Potato viruses
items.query: ("Potato virus Y" OR "Potato leafroll virus" OR "potato virus") AND potato

items.name: Chilli leaf curl and mosaic
items.query: ("leaf curl" OR mosaic OR virus) AND (chilli OR chili OR "Capsicum annuum")

items.name: Viroids
items.query: viroid AND (plant OR crop OR potato OR citrus OR coconut)

groups.name: Nematode diseases
groups.query: (nematode OR Meloidogyne OR Heterodera OR Pratylenchus) AND (plant OR crop OR root)

items.name: Root-knot nematode
items.query: ("root-knot nematode" OR "root knot nematode" OR Meloidogyne)

items.name: Cyst nematodes
items.query: ("cyst nematode" OR Heterodera OR Globodera)

items.name: Lesion and burrowing nematodes
items.query: (Pratylenchus OR Radopholus OR "lesion nematode" OR "burrowing nematode")

groups.name: Oomycete diseases
groups.query: (Phytophthora OR Pythium OR oomycete) AND (plant OR crop OR disease)

items.name: Phytophthora diseases
items.query: Phytophthora AND (plant OR crop OR disease OR blight OR rot)

items.name: Pythium diseases
items.query: Pythium AND (plant OR crop OR seedling OR "damping-off")

groups.name: Parasitic plants and weeds
groups.query: ("parasitic plant" OR Striga OR Orobanche OR Cuscuta OR "parasitic weed")

items.name: Striga (witchweed)
items.query: Striga AND (crop OR sorghum OR maize OR millet OR parasitic)

items.name: Orobanche (broomrape)
items.query: Orobanche OR broomrape OR Phelipanche

items.name: Cuscuta (dodder)
items.query: Cuscuta OR dodder AND plant

groups.name: Abiotic and physiological disorders
groups.query: ("physiological disorder" OR "abiotic stress" OR "nutrient deficiency") AND (plant OR crop)

items.name: Nutrient deficiencies
items.query: ("nutrient deficiency" OR "nitrogen deficiency" OR "iron deficiency" OR "zinc deficiency" OR "boron deficiency" OR chlorosis) AND (plant OR crop)

items.name: Blossom-end rot and calcium disorders
items.query: ("blossom-end rot" OR "blossom end rot" OR "bitter pit" OR "tip burn") AND (plant OR fruit OR tomato OR apple)

items.name: Sunscald, heat and cold injury
items.query: (sunscald OR "heat injury" OR "chilling injury" OR "frost injury" OR "frost damage") AND (plant OR crop OR fruit)

items.name: Herbicide and chemical injury
items.query: ("herbicide injury" OR "herbicide damage" OR phytotoxicity) AND (plant OR crop)
